notes.title: Patch Notes: Altazar Has Arrived!
notes.content:
Hello DragonSouls!

A new wave of magic surges through Heroes of Mount Dragon 🐉... The latest update unveils a powerful new force: Altazar 🧙‍♂️ joins the cast! His command of the mystic arts is without equal, and none alive can bend the will of the arcane crystals as he can.


[previewyoutube="ufJWd62ih9Y;full"][/previewyoutube]🆕New Content
New playable character: Altazar joins the roster!

New Achievements for Altazar and Tiberius at maximum level
⚙️Improvements
Can now disable crossplay via a new gameplay setting

Moderation menu for online games
🐞Bug Fixes
Overall stability and performance improvements.

Fix long username that could be cropped in Hud

Some narrative subtitles could get stuck forever

There's 2 more characters coming up in the near future, stay tuned!

May the Celestial Dragon be with you!

notes.title: Patch Notes: Tiberius Joins the Fight!
notes.content:
Hello DragonSouls!

Today we’re unleashing a fresh new update packed with improvements, bug fixes, and something special: a brand-new character joins the fight! Say hello to Tiberius, a fierce new contender who brings raw power and style to the battlefield. Are you ready to test his mettle?


[previewyoutube="qiJwx6laajs;full"][/previewyoutube]

🆕New Content
New playable character: Tiberius joins the roster!
⚙️Improvements
Sprint: Added the ability to sprint using the L1 button.

Game Over: The game over screen now triggers only when all players are defeated in multiplayer.

Move List: All local heroes' moves are now accessible in the Move List menu.

Character Selection: In Adventure Mode, players can now change selected heroes at any time by backing out from the map.

Boss Tuning: Morloch (Act 4) now has longer vulnerability windows and a lower total HP for a more dynamic fight.

Combat: Adjusted airborne hang time for enemies to allow better chaining.
🐞Bug Fixes
Overall stability and performance improvements.

Re-compressed movies to reduce install size.

Fixed connection and player count issues with lobbies.

Fixed unintended FPS limits that could override player settings.

Fixed crash when quitting during the level introduction sequence.

Fixed issues with phase transitions causing some bosses to freeze.

Fixed issues where upgrades were not correctly applied during game sessions.



We can’t wait to see what you think of Tiberius. Dive back in, explore the new flow, and share your thoughts!

May the Celestial Dragon be with you!

—The Dev Team

notes.title: A new version of the Heroes of Mount Dragon demo is available!
notes.content:
RuniQ Studio has released its latest demo for their highly anticipated couch co-op brawler, Heroes of Mount Dragon, launching in June on Steam.

Players can now test out the game either solo or with their friends online starting today!

DEMO KEY FEATURES

🔥Refined Combat System: Based on player feedback, we have implemented improvements to combat, ensuring better balanced encounters and the removal of frustrating attack chain interruptions for a smoother and more engaging experience. 

⚔️Competitive Mode Unlocked: Players can now test their skills against friends in the newly unlocked Competitive Mode! Face off in local or online matches to earn the title of Mount Dragon’s ultimate champion. Utilize a variety of devious curses – electrify, shrink or flip your rivals' controls – to disrupt their gameplay and seize victory. 

🕷️New Kingdom to Explore – The Elven Sanctuary: Venture into the mysterious and enchanting Elven Sanctuary, a brand-new kingdom teeming with Dark Elves, cunning Witches and lurking Spiders. Discover its secrets and face its formidable inhabitants. 

💬Now Available in the Following Languages: French, Italian, German, Spanish (Spain), Portuguese (Brazil), Japanese, Korean, and Simplified Chinese. 

Wishlist & Subscribe

Don’t forget to add Heroes of Mount Dragon to your Wishlist, and keep tuned for exciting news in the coming weeks!

notes.title: HEROES OF MOUNT DRAGON OPENS ITS FIRST CLOSED BETA TO PLAYERS
notes.content:
Indie game studio RuniQ announced the upcoming closed beta for its co-op side-scrolling brawler, Heroes of Mount Dragon. Players interested in participating can sign up for the closed beta now on the Steam page. The closed beta will officially commence on May 1, 2025, at 1 PM EDT until May 12, 2025, at 1 PM EDT.

New Key Features in Closed Beta:


 Refined Combat System: Based on player feedback, RuniQ has implemented improvements to combat, ensuring better balanced encounters and the removal of frustrating attack chain interruptions for a smoother and more engaging experience.

 Competitive Mode Unlocked: Players can now test their skills against friends in the newly unlocked Competitive Mode! Face off in local or online matches to earn the title of Mount Dragon’s ultimate champion. Utilize a variety of devious curses – electrify, shrink or flip your rivals' controls – to disrupt their gameplay and seize victory.

 New Kingdom to Explore – The Elven Sanctuary:  Venture into the mysterious and enchanting Elven Sanctuary, a brand-new kingdom teeming with Dark Elves, cunning Witches and lurking Spiders. Discover its secrets and face its formidable inhabitants.

Keep in mind the game is still in development, so you might encounter a few minor bugs or glitches along the way. Please join our Discord to report these issues.

May the force of the dragon be with you!

notes.title: HEROES OF MOUNT DRAGON LAUNCHING ON PC IN JUNE
notes.content:
Indie studio RuniQ today announced its co-op side-scrolling brawler, Heroes of Mount Dragon, is launching this June, with the first playable demo now available on Steam as part of this week’s Steam Couch Co-Op Festival. 

Heroes of Mount Dragon is a nostalgic blend of fantasy and colorful Saturday morning cartoons with hand-drawn 2D realms and textures seamlessly integrated into a vibrant 3D environment. Players can experience thrilling side-scrolling action in this fast-paced brawler, selecting from an array of dragon-morphing heroes and battles alongside or against friends, both locally or online. These heroes unleash unique powerful abilities, utilize strategic power-ups and even sabotage opponents with mischievous curses! 

Heroes of Mount Dragon’s Core features include: 

Frantic Beat ‘Em Up with 8* Unique Dragon-Morphing Heroes, each with their own unique skill sets and combos
Players can transform into a powerful dragon that can unleash devastating attacks  
Players unlock powerful upgrades to level up during their progress through the adventure
*Note: Only four characters will be available at launch in June. The other four characters will be included in the following months.  

Collaborate or Compete in Varied Game Modes 

Play on the couch or online co-op with or against friends on all platforms 
Enjoy the adventure and arcade mode with up to three friends, or challenge them in the competitive mode, trying to become THE best hero of Mount Dragon. 

Use Powerups to Help You Win or Curse Other Players  

 Acquire powerups to help face the onslaught of monsters 
 Use a variety of devious curses to mess with rivals—electrify them, shrink them or flip their controls 

Colorful Artistic Style and Tongue-in-cheek Attitude 

 Vibrant 2D realms, crafted with numerous unique hand-drawn textures, are seamlessly integrated into a 3D environment 
 Feels like a modern-day Saturday morning cartoon 
 Light-hearted tone that doesn’t take itself (too) seriously 

Heroes of Mount Dragon releases this June on PC. The full roster of characters will follow soon in future game updates. Players can Wishlist the game on Steam and follow the game on Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, and Discord to be informed on further announcements and its release date! 

About RuniQ Studio 

RuniQ is an independent game development studio based in Quebec City, Canada.  Founded by three industry veterans from Beenox (Activision), the team brings a wealth of games development experience to the company from having worked on globally successful franchises such as Skylanders, Spider-Man, Crash Bandicoot, and Call of Duty. In partnership with HMD Creations and its Heroes of Mount Dragon multimedia IP (books, board games, puzzles, etc.), RuniQ is on a mission to develop captivating video games set in this universe.  Since its inception, RuniQ has garnered significant recognition, winning the ninth edition of the Catapulte Pitching Contest as well as GDC Pitch Day in 2024. The company was also selected for Quebec City’s Valo-Capitale grant and received support from the Canada Media Fund, underscoring its potential as a standout in the gaming industry.  

More information about the team can be found on https://www.studioruniq.com  
More information about the universe can be found on https://www.herosdumontdragon.com/en
